en.body:
The path to the best ending in **Castlevania: Belmont's Curse** is paved with secrets, and one of the most crucial gates is the Judge's Test. While not strictly necessary to simply finish the game, passing this enigmatic trial is key to experiencing the full narrative and securing the coveted true ending. This involves a combination of thorough exploration, skillful platforming, and a significant investment in your character's growth.

## Unlocking the Judge's Arcana

The Judge Arcana resides within the Palace of Justice, a location you'll find shortly after escaping the Catacombs of Paris. Following the path upwards and right from the initial emergence, you'll bypass the cog wheels leading to a save point and instead proceed to the Court of Justice. Navigate your way to the top of this multi-tiered structure, and you'll discover the entrance to the Palace of Justice. Within its halls, a grand tree and a set of imposing scales await. To unlock the Judge Arcana, you must meet a specific upgrade threshold: at least four full health hearts and four full mana hearts. This equates to a total of 16 health and 16 mana upgrades, boosting your maximum HP and MP to 180 each. Once this condition is met, you can approach the scales.

## Passing the Judge's Trial

With the necessary upgrades in tow, the Judge's Test itself becomes a matter of sacrifice. You must stand on the higher end of the scale, positioning yourself to absorb the corruption emanating from the heart on the opposing side. This process demands a substantial amount of your health and mana, hence the prerequisite for ample upgrades. Successfully absorbing this corruption will not only grant you the Judge Arcana but also reward you with the legendary level four sword, a powerful tool that will undoubtedly aid you in the challenging final encounters. This entire endeavor is an integral part of the quest to achieve the true ending, making it a must-do for any player invested in **Castlevania: Belmont's Curse**'s deeper lore and challenges.

## What's Next

With the Judge's Test conquered and the true ending within reach, players can now focus on mastering the remaining challenges and uncovering any other hidden secrets **Castlevania: Belmont's Curse** has to offer. The pursuit of the best ending is a testament to the game's intricate design, rewarding dedication and exploration.

content_raw: While you don't need this Arcana to finish Castlevania: Belmont's Curse , getting the best ending does require you to meet a bunch of cryptic requirements. One is the Judge Arcana card, which is relatively simple to finish on paper, but you may need to backtrack to some difficult puzzles throughout Dracula's castle. This is because you will need certain upgrades found mostly in optional platforming puzzle areas where you need proficiency with the use of skills such as the Arcane Whip, dashing, double-jumping, and Holy Light skills to get the reward. Of course, you may also find one of the many relics or weapons at the end of them instead, but that's arguably a more tempting prize, even if it doesn't help with the Judge's test. With all that in mind, below are the steps you need to take to pass the test and get one step closer to the best ending for this metroidvania adventure. Rose needs to sacrifice enough mana and health to tip the scales back to an even level. How to unlock the Judge Arcana To find the Judge Arcana, as soon as you emerge from the Catacombs of Paris after Castlevania rises from beneath the city, head up and left. You'll pass under the big bridge, leading up to the platform cog wheels that take you to a save point on your left. Instead, head right to the next screen - the Court of Justice. Get to the top of the multi-storey building, and you'll see the entrance to the Palace of Justice. Enter and make your way through the building until you see a big tree and some scales. This is the aforementioned Judge Arcana, and to unlock it, you'll need enough upgrades to fill at least four full health and mana hearts, respectively. That is 16 of each upgrade, which will make your max HP and MP 180. Once you reach this threshold, hold the RB/RT button to absorb the evil from the scales until the two sides align perfectly. Doing so awakens the tree, which will eventually give you its Arcana spell. One of the many health upgrades that's tucked away behind jumping puzzles. Tips for finding health and mana upgrades If you want to find the necessary upgrades for yourself, here are a few tips to get you thinking in the right space to find them: If you see a room with lots of spikes or spinning blades, there's a good chance there's an upgrade at the end, especially if the room is an offshoot of the main path. The map shows which areas you haven't got every upgrade for in gray. If you don't highlight the area and it's gold, you've discovered everything. Zooming out of the map fully will give you the completion percentage for that area. This includes all weapons, relics, Arcana, and health/mana upgrades.
